target.title: fix(media-understanding): downscale configured image descriptions
target.body:
Closes #101923

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users sending oversized images through media-understanding flows could still hit provider image-size failures even after configuring `agents.defaults.imageMaxDimensionPx` and `agents.defaults.imageQuality`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Media-understanding image preparation now hands configured image compression policy to the existing shared web-media optimizer before provider execution. The no-policy path keeps the existing pass-through behavior, HEIC normalization still runs first, and MIME-less local GIF paths infer their MIME from the filename so animated GIFs stay on the shared GIF-preserving path.

## User Impact

Configured media-understanding image description calls can downscale oversized image inputs consistently with the shared image resize ladder. This helps channel and CLI image-description workflows avoid preventable provider rejects for large photos when users have configured image bounds.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the change and understand the normalizer, configured policy, MIME inference, and test coverage in this PR. A sanitized local agent transcript was not included because this automation run did not have interactive approval to attach one.

## Evidence

- `/Users/harjothk/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/media-understanding/runtime.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` passed (23 tests).
- `/Users/harjothk/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/media-understanding/runtime.test.ts src/media-understanding/media-understanding-misc.test.ts src/media/web-media.test.ts src/agents/tools/image-tool.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` passed (3 Vitest shards: media 75 tests, media-understanding 42 tests, agents image-tool 94 tests).
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- `/Users/harjothk/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3 .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` passed clean after addressing the GIF MIME finding.

Not run: live Anthropic/OpenClaw image-description repro with a real oversized phone photo; this PR proves the local source path and shared compression handoff.
